title: GOOSE frame with non-empty allData
purpose: Retain a strong GOOSE seed and improve parser depth by making allData non-empty while preserving documented field tags and coherent lengths.
expected_behavior: A GOOSE-capable implementation should identify EtherType 0x88b8, parse outer tag 0x61, process the standard field tags, and continue into a non-empty allData field.
constraints_preserved: Preserves documented GOOSE outer APDU tag 0x61.
Uses only documented field tags 0x80 through 0x8a and 0xab.
All TLV lengths, including the outer APDU length, are internally consistent.
allData is present and non-empty to increase data-path coverage.
issue_safety_notes: No issue-driven or malformed GOOSE payload is used; values are bounded and mutation-friendly.
